Eight rules that replace the M3E component anatomy. Where a component on the following boards looks unusual, one of these is the reason.
Enabled glass is glossy and lit. Disabled glass dries to a matte, desaturated frost with content at 38%. Nothing else signals disabled.
Glass, frost, clear and pearl stand off the surface and are pressed. Wells sit below it and are typed or dragged in.
Unchosen options rest in wells; choosing one raises it into glass. The current tab or tool is a frost lens.
Content lives on milk panes and passing messages on ink. Glass may sit on milk, but never on other glass.
A lens is not a second sheet
A lens inside a clear bar is the same glass, thickened. It adds light, never a second shadow or rim stack.
